note: Triennial election of Down County Council on the 20 single-member county electoral divisions; nominations received by R. J. Dickson, returning officer, at Downpatrick on 4 May 1927. Colonel Sharman-Crawford, chairman for many years, was not nominated. Polls in Castlewellan and Rathfriland on Thursday 2 June 1927, declared at the County Courthouse, Downpatrick, the next day; the other eighteen were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 5 May and 4 June 1927). No party labels are printed, so none are given. Gordon had represented Kilkeel since 1924. M'Spadden's total is broken in the News-Letter's print and read from the Northern Whig (1,006).
